en: Black‑and‑white view of a central European town square at the foot of a steep wooded hill. In the foreground is a small landscaped square with trees, paths, and a few people walking. Surrounding it are richly ornamented 4‑ to 5‑storey historicist buildings with shops at street level and awnings over the windows. Signs on the façades are in German, including one large sign reading "NEUDORFER" on the right and another building labeled "BÖRSE". The scene appears to be from the late 19th or early 20th century.
